notes: Every release zip holds one file at its root: ninja (Linux/macOS) or ninja.exe. No other files, no configuration, no registry, no environment needed; it reads only build.ninja in the directory it is run in.

recipes.notes: Run 2026-09-18: 1.13.2 and 1.6.0 unzipped into folders with spaces, `ninja --version`, then used by CMake 3.13.5/3.31.12/4.4.3 and Meson 1.11.1/1.12.0 to build a hello-world C project. The zip stores Unix mode 0755; the chmod covers unzip code that doesn't apply it. Links only libc/libstdc++/libgcc.

launch.notes: Build tool, not an app runtime.

project_install.notes: Ninja has no project install of its own: CMake (-G Ninja) and Meson run it. The runtime folder is put on PATH for their project_install commands (both find `ninja` on PATH; Meson also honours NINJA=<path>, which should then point here). NINJA_STATUS only changes the progress line.

recipes.notes: Not run on Windows; floors from the PE headers and imports of every ninja.exe (kernel32.dll only, statically linked CRT, no redistributable). The x86 1.6.0 build is the only choice for XP and for 32-bit Windows of any version. 1.7.2's ninja-win.zip is a dead link (404).
